WITH CTE_YEAR_CURRENT AS ( /* LGVPAY00034.retrieveAlSumaryEmpList */ SELECT SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, SUM(NVL(OCCUR_BASIC_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS, 0)) AS TOTAL_BASIC_CURR, SUM(CASE WHEN TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM = #{payMonth} THEN 0 WHEN ANNUAL_CALIBRATION_DAYS > 0 THEN ANNUAL_CALIBRATION_DAYS ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_CALIB_CURR, SUM(NVL(USE_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS, 0)) AS TOTAL_USE_CURR, SUM(NVL(OCCUR_MONTHLY_ANN_LV_DAYS, 0)) AS TOTAL_OCCUR_CURR, NVL(MAX(RESIDUAL_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM), 0) AS LATEST_RESIDUAL_LEAVE FROM TB_ATT_ANNUAL_LEAVE_N WHERE TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM LIKE SUBSTR(#{payMonth}, 1, 4) || '%' GROUP BY SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO ), CTE_YEAR_PREVIOUS AS ( SELECT SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM = TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{payMonth}, 1, 4)) - 1) || '12' THEN RESIDUAL_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS END), 0) AS RESIDUAL_DEC_PREV, NVL(MAX(CASE WHEN TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM = TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{payMonth}, 1, 4)) - 1) || '12' THEN OCCUR_MONTHLY_ANN_LV_DAYS END), 0) AS OCCUR_MONTHLY_DEC_PREV, SUM(NVL(USE_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS, 0)) AS TOTAL_USE_PREV FROM TB_ATT_ANNUAL_LEAVE_N WHERE TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM LIKE TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{payMonth}, 1, 4)) - 1) || '%' GROUP BY SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO ), CTE_PREV_MONTH_ATT AS ( SELECT R.SUBSIDIARY_CODE, R.EMPLOYEE_NO, SUM(DECODE(B.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE,'NW',1,'PH',1,0)) PREV_PERFECT_DAYS FROM TB_ATT_RESULT_N R, TB_ATT_CODE_C C, TB_ATT_BASE_BAS_N B WHERE R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = C.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE AND R.SHIFT_TYPE_CODE = B.SHIFT_TYPE_CODE AND R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE = B.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE AND R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{payMonth}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY R.SUBSIDIARY_CODE, R.EMPLOYEE_NO ),
CTE_ATT AS ( SELECT R.SUBSIDIARY_CODE, R.EMPLOYEE_NO, SUBSTR(R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM, 5, 2) AS MM, SUM(DECODE(B.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE,'NW',1,'PH',1,0)) PERFECT_DAYS, SUM(CASE WHEN (C.PAID_DAYS > 0 OR C.ATTENDANCE_DAYS > 0 OR R.TIME_ATTEND_DETAIL_CODE = 'US_CHB') THEN 1 END) ACTUAL_DAYS, SUM(CASE WHEN (C.UNPAID_DAYS > 0 AND R.TIME_ATTEND_DETAIL_CODE != 'US_CHB') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNPAID_LEAVE FROM TB_ATT_RESULT_N R, TB_ATT_CODE_C C, TB_ATT_BASE_BAS_N B WHERE R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = C.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE AND R.SHIFT_TYPE_CODE = B.SHIFT_TYPE_CODE AND R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE = B.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE AND R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM LIKE SUBSTR(#{payMonth}, 1, 4) || '%' GROUP BY R.SUBSIDIARY_CODE, R.EMPLOYEE_NO, SUBSTR(R.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM, 5, 2) ), CTE_AL AS ( SELECT SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, SUBSTR(TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM, 5, 2) AS MM, SUM(NVL(USE_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS, 0)) AS ANNUAL_LEAVE_USED FROM TB_ATT_ANNUAL_LEAVE_N WHERE TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM LIKE SUBSTR(#{payMonth}, 1, 4) || '%' GROUP BY SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, SUBSTR(TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM, 5, 2) ), CTE_COMBINED AS ( SELECT SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, MM, PERFECT_DAYS, ACTUAL_DAYS, UNPAID_LEAVE, 0 AS ANNUAL_LEAVE_USED FROM CTE_ATT UNION ALL SELECT SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, MM, 0 AS PERFECT_DAYS, 0 AS ACTUAL_DAYS, 0 AS UNPAID_LEAVE, ANNUAL_LEAVE_USED FROM CTE_AL ), CTE_SUMMARY AS ( SELECT SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, MM, SUM(PERFECT_DAYS) AS PERFECT_DAYS, SUM(ACTUAL_DAYS) AS ACTUAL_DAYS, SUM(UNPAID_LEAVE) AS UNPAID_LEAVE, (CASE WHEN SUM(PERFECT_DAYS) = 0 THEN 1 WHEN SUM(ACTUAL_DAYS) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN (SUM(ACTUAL_DAYS) / SUM(PERFECT_DAYS)) < 0.5 THEN 0.5 ELSE 1 END) AS WORK_COEF, SUM(ANNUAL_LEAVE_USED) AS ANNUAL_LEAVE_USED FROM CTE_COMBINED GROUP BY SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NO, MM )

GROUP BY EM.SUBSIDIARY_CODE, EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, EM.DATE_HIRE_SUBSIDIARY, EM.DATE_RETIRE ) SRC ON ( TGT.SUBSIDIARY_CODE = SRC.SUBSIDIARY_CODE AND TGT.EMPLOYEE_NO = SRC.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AND TGT.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM = #{payMonth} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TGT.ANNUAL_COMPENSATION_DAYS = SRC.AL_PAY_COUNT, TGT.ANNUAL_CALIBRATION_DAYS = SRC.AL_PAY_ADJUST, TGT.RESIDUAL_ANNUAL_LEAVE_DAYS = 0, TGT.LAST_UPDATE_USER_ID = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}, TGT.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
